laws.name: pseudo-inverse, closed loop
laws.author: Hertzforge
laws.summary: Starts from the regularized pseudo-inverse drive, then each loop corrects a lower-triangular factor of the reference from the measured error (Smallwood's coupling-matrix correction), autospectra first in channel order, each factor diagonal and each drive PSD held to a per-loop limit, the sources held to the plant's rank. Every drive is positive semi-definite by construction.

params.label: Regularization
params.help: How the inverse of the plant treats weak directions. Truncated drops singular values below the amount times the largest; Tikhonov damps every one with the amount times the largest as the damping; none inverts every singular value above the numerical floor.

params.label: Regularization amount
params.help: Relative to the largest singular value on each line. For truncation, 1e-3 keeps the inverse's condition number under 1,000. Ignored with no regularization.

params.label: Convergence factor
params.help: The fraction of each loop's correction applied. 1 applies it whole; smaller values converge more slowly and average estimation noise.

params.label: Largest rise per loop
params.help: The most any drive's PSD, or any factor diagonal's square, may rise in one loop. Never looser than the controller's own cap.

params.label: Largest fall per loop
params.help: The most any drive's PSD, or any factor diagonal's square, may fall in one loop. Never looser than the controller's own cap.

params.label: Rank tolerance
params.help: Singular values of the plant above this fraction of the largest count toward its rank. The reference factor keeps no more independent sources than the rank.

params.label: Error weighting
params.help: How the least-squares inverse weighs each control's error when there are more controls than drives: equally, or relative to its reference PSD so a quiet control counts as much as a loud one. No effect on a square plant.

diagnostics.label: Condition number
diagnostics.help: Largest over smallest singular value of the plant on each line (weighted when the law weights). 0 out of band; 1e300 on a singular line.

diagnostics.label: Singular values kept
diagnostics.help: How many singular values of the plant the inverse used on each line.

diagnostics.label: Largest drive change
diagnostics.help: The largest change of any drive's PSD on any line from the law's previous drive. 0 at the seed.

diagnostics.label: Clamped factor diagonals
diagnostics.help: Diagonal elements of the reference factor whose correction this loop was held to the per-loop limit, over all lines.
